Room Rental Agreement (template)

For renting a single room in a shared home (roommates or a live-in landlord). Replace every [BRACKETED] value. Not legal advice — see DISCLAIMER.

ROOM RENTAL AGREEMENT

Made on [DATE] between [PRIMARY TENANT / OWNER NAME] ("Provider") and [ROOM RENTER NAME] ("Renter") for a room at [PROPERTY ADDRESS].

1. Room & shared areas. Renter rents the room described as [ROOM DESCRIPTION] and may use these shared areas: [kitchen, bathroom, living room, etc.].

2. Term. [Fixed term with dates / month-to-month].

3. Rent. $[AMOUNT] per month, due [DAY]. Included: [utilities/internet?].

4. Deposit. $[AMOUNT].

5. House rules. [Quiet hours, guests, cleaning, smoking, pets, shared-expense split, etc.]

6. Termination. [# DAYS] written notice by either party.

7. Governing law. Laws of [STATE].

Provider: __________________ Date: ______
Renter: __________________ Date: ______
